items.title: Terry Gibbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Let me first use a line that Dick Cavett said... Dick Cavett once had Lester Maddox on his show.

ctx.x: When you went out to Los Angeles. What was the scene between black and white musicians like at that point?

You know it’s a weird thing. Let me first use a line that Dick Cavett said, “I’d never look” — before I say this Dick Cavett once had Lester Maddox on his show. You know Lester Maddox who was a mayor in Alabama?
